items.title: Muggsy Spanier Interview, 1961-02-02
items.q: I heard him in the late years.

ctx.x: Is there anything more about, oh, one other fellow while I think of it, Tommy Ladner. I know you once mentioned him years ago. Oh, yes.

Yes. Tommy was sort of on the style of Joe Oliver's playing. Very similar. In fact, when Louie went to New York with Fletcher Henderson, Tommy Ladner took his place with Joe. And Tommy Ladner, because he could really blow. I heard him in the late years.

He was good even 19, oh, 38 and 39, right before he died I heard him. In those days, I remember some old Paramount ads and they called him the praying trumpet. Did he use a lot of that mute feature, that mute style or anything or sort of like, say, you'd plunge your style or anything. Was he specializing in that those days?
